title: About page
summary: About page at /about. Enable equals the menu entry. This plugin mounts the React page.

blocks.title: Page plugin
blocks.text: package.json tuucho.kind page, route /about. This plugin mounts the about React page. While enabled, the kernel puts the route on the shop menu (nav.key / order). Disable and the URL and menu entry go away.

items.description: While Sitemap pages is on, the kernel lists this route on seo.sitemap.entries. Extra paths that are not this route must register the filter yourself (Guides does /pose and /capsules).
